Election.title: BV2291 — Bloc STAR vs STAR-PR - no faction has a majority
Election.description: One hundred and one voters fill four seats from ten candidates, counted TWICE on the identical 0-5 ballots. No faction has a majority: Blue 40%, Green 35%, Amber 26%. Jaya runs as an independent, is nobody's first choice, and is scored 3 or 4 by everyone - and wins the first seat outright on breadth rather than depth, which is the thing a 0-5 ballot can see and a choose-one ballot cannot. But the SECOND-LARGEST faction, Green at 35%, elects nobody under Bloc STAR, while Amber at 26% wins a seat: bloc seat allocation does not track faction size. STAR-PR gives each faction one seat plus the independent. Nothing here is settled by a tie- break. [Full lesson & tabulation](https://masiarek.github.io/star-voting-library/02_STAR_Bloc/02_Examples/bloc_shapes/cases/cases_pages/bloc_no_majority_bridge.html)

races.title: BV2291 — Fill 4 seats - STAR-PR / Allocated Score (proportional)

logs: 4 winners will represent 101 voters, so winners will need to represent a quota of 25.25 voters each.
Jaya is scored highest with 324 stars and is elected!
The 21 voters who gave Jaya more than 3 stars are fully represented and will be removed from future rounds.
The 80 voters who gave Jaya 3 stars are partially represented. 5% of their remaining vote will go toward Jaya and 95% will be preserved for future rounds.
Bram is scored highest with 170.44 stars and is elected!
Bram and Ada are tied for the highest scores!
The 30.3 voters who gave Bram 4.73 stars are partially represented. 83% of their remaining vote will go toward Bram and 17% will be preserved for future rounds.
Dov is scored highest with 132.56 stars and is elected!
Dov and Esme are tied for the highest scores!
The 26.51 voters who gave Dov 4.73 stars are partially represented. 95% of their remaining vote will go toward Dov and 5% will be preserved for future rounds.
Hank is scored highest with 101 stars and is elected!
Hank and Gita are tied for the highest scores!
The 23.99 voters who gave Hank more than 0.05 stars are fully represented and will be removed from future rounds.
The 1.26 voters who gave Hank 0.05 stars are partially represented. 100% of their remaining vote will go toward Hank and 0% will be preserved for future rounds.
